title: Jaunt stops no longer stand behind a tree
items: Arriving at a house on a jaunt, or by Go to, now steps a metre or two along the walk when a parkway elm, gas lamp or pole would stand between you and the front. The Women of Prairie Avenue stop at 1834 Prairie no longer puts a trunk in the middle of the view.
On foot, 17 of the 57 Prairie Avenue houses the 1904 walks visit had a trunk or lamp right in front of the camera; none do now. In 1835 the grown trees' trunks are seen the same way.
